stops.note: combining 'som' (sour) and 'tam' (pounded), naming a spicy salad made by pounding shredded green papaya
Thai 'sour pounded', from the mortar in which the green papaya is bruised; from Isan and Laos
stops.meaning: a spicy Thai green papaya salad

current_meaning: a spicy, tangy Thai salad made from pounded shredded green papaya
